tasks.goal: Greet the mechanic and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the mechanic and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Describe grinding brake noise heard when slowing car down
tasks.hint: Inform mechanic what vehicle issue brought you in.
tasks.done_when: Learner described grinding brake sound when slowing down.

tasks.goal: Inquire about diagnostic engine code scan and inspection cost
tasks.hint: Ask mechanic fee to diagnose check engine light.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about diagnostic scan fee.

tasks.goal: Ask if brake pads and rotors both require immediate replacement
tasks.hint: Inquire about severity of brake wear.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if brake pads and rotors need replacing.
tasks.scene_hint: Hydraulic car lift hums loudly as impact wrenches rattle in shop bays.

tasks.goal: Inquire about synthetic oil change prices and oil filter replacement
tasks.hint: Ask routine maintenance costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about synthetic oil change pricing.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'estimate'
tasks.hint: An estimate is an approximate calculation of the cost or time required for a service. Ask the mechanic for a written repair estimate.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'estimate'.

tasks.goal: Ask how long repair work will take before car is ready
tasks.hint: Inquire about labor turnaround time.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about estimated repair completion time.

tasks.goal: Negotiate discount on labor fees after receiving expensive repair estimate
tasks.hint: Politely ask mechanic if quote can be reduced.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated discount on repair labor quote.

tasks.goal: Ask if replaced worn auto parts will be shown to you after repair
tasks.hint: Inquire to verify old parts replaced.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to see old replaced parts.

tasks.goal: Express concern when mechanic discovers additional leaking radiator hose
tasks.hint: Respond to newly reported repair complication.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed newly discovered radiator hose leak.
tasks.scene_hint: Motor oil aroma and metal workbench tool chests line garage walls.

tasks.goal: Ask if repair work comes with 12-month parts and labor warranty
tasks.hint: Inquire about warranty protection on repairs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about repair parts and labor warranty.

tasks.goal: Confirm itemized cost breakdown of parts versus labor hours
tasks.hint: Verify invoice math with shop clerk.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed parts vs labor cost breakdown.

tasks.goal: Request official printed work order receipt showing repaired items
tasks.hint: Ask for detailed repair receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed auto repair work order.

tasks.goal: Verify accepted credit card payment options upon collecting car keys
tasks.hint: Confirm payment method before receiving keys.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified payment methods upon picking up keys.

tasks.goal: Thank the mechanic and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the mechanic AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about shop labor rate per hour and basic diagnostic inspection fees
tasks.hint: Ask mechanic shop hourly labor charge.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shop hourly labor rates.
tasks.scene_hint: Pneumatic wrenches whine and metallic tools clatter as a car is raised on a hydraulic lift.

tasks.goal: Ask if shuttle service or loaner vehicle is available while car is being repaired
tasks.hint: Inquire about temporary transportation options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shop shuttle or loaner vehicle.
tasks.scene_hint: The smell of motor oil and rubber tires fills the garage service desk area.

tasks.goal: Inquire about estimated timeframe for completing diagnostic vehicle scan
tasks.hint: Ask mechanic how long initial scan takes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about diagnostic inspection timeline.
tasks.scene_hint: Hydraulic lift hums as silver sedan raises slowly above oily concrete floor.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'vibration'
tasks.hint: Vibration refers to rapid back-and-forth movement or shaking in a vehicle. Mention that you notice a heavy steering vibration at high speeds.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'vibration'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'caliper'
tasks.hint: A brake caliper squeezes brake pads against the spinning rotor to stop the vehicle. Ask if the front left brake caliper is sticking or leaking fluid.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'caliper'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'manifold'
tasks.hint: A manifold is a pipe assembly directing intake air or exhaust gases to or from engine cylinders. Inquire if an exhaust manifold crack causes the engine ticking sound.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'manifold'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'alternator'
tasks.hint: An alternator converts mechanical energy into electricity to charge the vehicle battery. Inquire if dim headlights signal a failing alternator.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'alternator'.

tasks.goal: Ask about brake pad thickness measurement and rotor resurfacing necessity
tasks.hint: Inquire if brake rotors need replacement or machining.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about brake pad thickness and rotor condition.
tasks.scene_hint: A worn brake rotor and caliper assembly sit on the shop workbench for inspection.

tasks.goal: Inquire if check engine light code scan reveals specific cylinder misfire numbers
tasks.hint: Ask mechanic for exact OBD-II diagnostic trouble codes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about OBD check engine code details.
tasks.scene_hint: A hand-held OBD2 diagnostic scanner plugged under a dashboard chirps with error codes.

tasks.goal: Ask whether engine oil leak originates from upper engine seals or lower oil pan
tasks.hint: Inquire where oil seepage is located.

tasks.goal: Point out squeaking sound heard when turning steering wheel at low speeds

tasks.goal: Inquire about wheel alignment adjustment after replacing front struts and shocks

tasks.goal: Request written price estimate break down separating parts cost from shop labor

tasks.goal: Ask about air conditioning refrigerant leak detection using UV dye testing
